item.title: Dynamic Proxy Envoy
item.description: Envoy is the third project to graduate from the CNCF, and thanks to features like dynamic configuration and high performance it has become the de facto data plane standard in cloud native. Many projects rely on Envoy to handle data plane traffic while focusing their own efforts on adapting the control plane to their application scenarios, writing user input into Envoy over the xDS protocol.
